title: Flags
description: Switch product modules, their surfaces and platform features on or off for every organization. Off hides it from the nav and its pages, and its API answers 404. A nested flag only applies while its parent is on. Superadmins keep access for inspection. Releases decide which cloud organizations see each module or page.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Each card is one module in the app rail. Its switch gates the whole module; the rows inside switch its surfaces and features one by one.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Features across the app shell, independent of any module.

releases.title: Releases
releases.description: On releases the item to every cloud organization. Off keeps it preview-only: only organizations on release preview (Admin → Organization) see it and can start work in it. Self-hosted always sees everything. New items start off.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: The full-page agent conversation, its threads, runs and memories.

studio.label: Studio
studio.description: Generate and every Studio surface below. Off hides the whole module.

studio_motion.label: Motion
studio_motion.description: Animated visuals authored as React code from a prompt and rendered in the isolated visual-code renderer. Needs that renderer deployed.

studio_storyboard.label: Storyboard
studio_storyboard.description: Multi-scene storyboard runs with characters and per-scene generation.

studio_clips.label: Clips
studio_clips.description: Long-form video ingestion, highlight detection and short clip generation.

studio_turbo.label: Turbo
studio_turbo.description: Turbo projects that produce many review drafts at once.

turbo_ideas.label: Turbo ideas
turbo_ideas.description: Turbo idea projects: turn brand data into a set of content ideas.

studio_editor.label: Editor
studio_editor.description: The Remotion timeline editor other Studio surfaces hand finished video to.

library.label: Library
